import json
prog = currentProgram
out = {"sha256": str(prog.getExecutableSHA256())}
# scan executable memory for the disp32 0x29b / 0x29a byte-operand patterns
# patterns: c6/c0/c1? <modrm> 9b 02 00 00 <imm>   (MOV byte [reg+0x29b], imm)
#           80 <modrm> 9b 02 00 00 <imm>          (CMP byte [reg+0x29b], imm)
fm = prog.getFunctionManager()
hits = {}
def scan(mem, pattern, tag):
    try:
        it = mem.findBytes(pattern, None, True, monitor)
        while it.hasNext():
            monitor.checkCancelled()
            addr = it.next()
            f = fm.getFunctionContaining(addr)
            fname = str(f.getName()) if f else ""
            faddr = str(f.getEntryPoint()) if f else ""
            hits.setdefault(faddr, {})[tag] = hits.setdefault(faddr, {}).get(tag, 0) + 1
    except Exception as e:
        out["err_"+tag] = str(e)
mem = prog.getMemory()
scan(mem, bytes([0x9b,0x02,0x00,0x00]), "0x29b_disp32")
out["hits"] = hits
print(json.dumps(out))
